text:
omar_sales: FYI - Prospect RidgeCare asked for an access-controls pack for the POC: SAML metadata, MFA enforcement proof, RBAC mapping, SCIM examples, and one service-account policy with rotation. Need by EOD tomorrow.

jena_security: We can produce redacted SAML metadata (signed), conditional access screenshot showing MFA rule, and a 30-day auth event CSV with hashed principals. We'll redact tenant names and emails.

tyler_se: I'll prepare an RBAC export (CSV) with columns role_key,display,scope,actions. I'll include an example: ingest_writer,Ingest Writer,project:ridge:data,[dataset:create,dataset:append]

abe_engineering: I'll add a SCIM mapping snippet and a service-account JSON sample for rotation policy. Example: {"id":"sa-pipeline-01","permissions": ["dataset:append"],"rotation_days":7}

maria_cs: I'll assemble a short cover note for the security reviewer and offer a 20-min walkthrough. Also mention we require an NDA addendum for raw logs >30d.

jena_security: Redaction rules: replace emails with <user_hash>, zero UUID suffixes, aggregate IPs. I'll run the scrub tool and drop artifacts to staging.

files-bot: upload complete -> staging/ridgecare-access-pack-197654 -> sha256: d34db33f... :white_check_mark:

omar_sales: Great. I'll send the bundle link with the cover note tomorrow morning. If they ask for live role mapping demo, we can book a session during the POC.

jena_security: Note: supported IdPs: Okta, AzureAD, OneLogin, Ping. We'll state MFA is enforced at IdP or via our conditional access; machine tokens are short-lived and scoped.

omar_sales: Thanks — closing thread once email sent. :thumbsup:
